title: Web shop: a residency pin relaxed in chat
reference: Turn 1 pins Singapore. Turn 2 is the user's own change of mind: the app must follow it (a req with regions listing both Singapore and Tokyo, a Tokyo DR replica) and must not refuse by citing the old pin. Review defect: a pin could not be relaxed, and the checker errored on every region group afterwards.

turns.ask: Please design a small web shop for customers in Southeast Asia: a storefront, a relational database and image storage. Customer data must stay in Singapore.
Actually we changed our mind: a disaster recovery replica of the database in Tokyo is fine now. Please add it.

title: Order API: Kubernetes ruled out, then allowed
reference: Turn 1 avoids the whole Kubernetes family (no ACK, ACS, ACK One, ASM, ACK Serverless, ACK Dedicated, ACK Edge or Dify on ACK). Turn 2 lifts it in the user's own words and the app must follow: ACK or ACS appears and no constraint-avoid finding is raised. Review defect: the avoid list covered three ids only.

turns.ask: We have no Kubernetes skills on the team, so keep the design completely free of Kubernetes. We need a REST order API, background workers and a PostgreSQL database.
We hired a platform team, so Kubernetes is fine now. Please move the API and the workers onto a managed Kubernetes cluster.

title: 예약 시스템: 국내 보관 요건과 재해 복구
reference: 서울 리전 하나에 모든 것을 둔다. 재해 복구는 같은 리전의 다중 가용 영역과 리전 내 백업으로 구성하며, 다른 리전이나 해외가 나오지 않는다. 설명 문장에서 해외 반출 없음을 말해도 오류로 잡히면 안 된다.

turns.ask: 개인정보는 한국 밖으로 나가면 안 됩니다. 서울 리전에 병원 예약 시스템을 설계해 주세요. 웹 서비스, 데이터베이스, 첨부 파일 저장소가 필요합니다.

title: 在线预约系统：数据留在新加坡，用户要求异地备份
reference: 全部留在新加坡。用户要求跨区域的异地备份时，保持固定的数据驻留要求，改用同一地域内的可用区和地域内备份，并用一句话说明；图表和说明文字里都不出现其他地域。

turns.ask: 请设计一个在线预约系统，包含网站、数据库和文件存储。客户数据必须留在新加坡。
请再加一个跨区域的异地备份，放在别的国家。

title: 주문 API: 쿠버네티스 금지 뒤에 서비스 메시 요청
reference: 쿠버네티스 계열 전체(ACK, ACS, ASM 포함)가 나오지 않는다. 서비스 메시를 요청받으면 MSE 같은 쿠버네티스가 아닌 대안으로 답한다.

turns.ask: 쿠버네티스는 사용하지 않습니다. 주문 REST API와 PostgreSQL 데이터베이스를 구성해 주세요.
마이크로서비스 사이의 트래픽을 관리할 서비스 메시도 추가해 주세요.

title: Payments portal: a country with two regions
reference: Malaysia has two open regions, Kuala Lumpur (ap-southeast-3) and Johor (ap-southeast-8); the pin lists both ids and the design stays in them. DR in the other Malaysian region is allowed; Singapore or any other country is not.

turns.ask: We run a payments portal for Malaysian banks: web front end, an application tier, a relational database and object storage. All customer data must remain in Malaysia.
Add disaster recovery for the database.

title: HR platform: data must stay in Europe
reference: The pin lists the open European regions (Frankfurt eu-central-1, London eu-west-1, Paris eu-west-2) and nothing outside Europe appears, including in the narration; a backup request outside Europe (Virginia) is declined with an in-Europe alternative.

turns.ask: We are building an HR platform for European employees: a web app, a database and document storage. For GDPR reasons all personal data must stay in Europe.
Our US parent company wants a nightly copy of the HR database in Virginia for their reporting.
